report:
5:39 AM update – Good morning, skiers and riders! Welcome to the Eldora snow report for Thanksgiving Day, Wednesday, November 25, 2026.

We've got so much to be grateful for—our devoted mountain crews who have worked so hard to get the mountain open and continue to crush, around the clock, to open more terrain; our amazing mountain and the beautiful natural environment we call home; and you, our devoted guests who make the Eldora community so special. Thank you!

Yesterday, our teams opened two more trails, Windmill and Klondike, bringing the total to two complete top-to-bottom runs, plus an amazing Woodward terrain park in the base area. What better way to kick off Thanksgiving Day with family and friends than to come spin a few laps at your backyard mountain? Grab a ride up on the RTD—it's time for Turkey Turns! 🦃 🏔️

NWS Weather Snapshot:  Partly sunny, then gradually becoming sunny, with a high near 41. Breezy, with a west wind of 13 to 18 mph.

Safety: No trees or glades will be open. Expect thin, early-season conditions on Opening Day and beyond. Be prepared to ski and ride safely and responsibly on Opening Day and all season long, bearing in mind Your Responsibility Code every time you hit the slopes.

Uphill/Nordic/Snowshoe Access is currently CLOSED. For the cross-country skiers, snowshoers, and uphill skiers out there, Eldora’s Nordic trail network and uphill access routes are NOT YET OPEN. Stay tuned here for updates.

Parking: We will begin charging fees for single-occupancy vehicle (SOV) arrivals sometime in December. Stay tuned here for updates on when fees will begin. Learn more about parking at Eldora here.

Stay informed: Before heading to the mountain this winter, always check this page, eldora.com/conditions, for the latest information and operational updates. You can also sign up for text alerts so you never miss a beat. Text one of the following keywords to (866) 965-6224 for alerts (message and data rates may apply).

  • ELDORA for general alerts
  • UPHILL for uphill-specific updates
  • NORDIC for Nordic updates.

Thanks for checking the Eldora snow report. We'll see you on the hill!

--

GENERAL INFORMATION

  • Lift Hours: 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM on weekdays, 8:30 AM to 4:00 PM on weekends. Lifts currently open: Alpenglow only.
     
  • Lodge Hours: 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM on weekdays, 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM on weekends. Lodges currently open: Timbers, West Wing, Lower Indian Peaks Lodge.
     
  • Pass & Ticket Services, Rental, and Retail: Please visit Lower Indian Peaks Lodge. 
     
  • Single-Occupancy Vehicle (SOV) Fees: Vehicles with two or more occupants may park for free seven days a week. Vehicles carrying only a driver will be charged $10 on weekends, during certain holiday periods, and on weekdays with 10 or more inches of new snow. Credit/debit is accepted; cash is not.
     
  • High-Occupancy Vehicle (HOV) Parking: Per Boulder County requirements, the Elk Lot (nearest to Alpenglow chair) is reserved seven days a week for vehicles with three or more occupants on a first-come, first-served basis. Learn more here.
     
  • EV Parking: Eldora provides 30 free ChargePoint EV charging stations. These premium parking spots are available on a first-come, first-served basis and are subject to the SOV policy above. To park in the EV lot, you MUST have an EV and be actively charging. If you are finished charging, please move your car to another non-EV space so others can use the chargers.
     
  • Easy, Convenient RTD Bus Service from Boulder: RTD’s NB route brings you from Downtown Boulder Station straight to the Alpenglow chairlift in about 40 minutes; riders 19 and under ride RTD for FREE through RTD's Zero Fare for Youth program. For schedule and fare info, visit rtd-denver.com.

name: Snow Report 2026-11-22 17:10:24
report:
LET’S GO. Eldora Mountain officially opens Tuesday, November 24! 

A huge thank you to every member of our team for the hard work it takes to get this mountain ready for another season. And an extra-special shoutout to our snowmaking crew, who have worked tirelessly to squeeze every flake possible out of every snowmaking window.  

Here’s what to expect Tuesday:

  •  Lifts: 9 AM–4 PM (Alpenglow lift only)
  • Lodges: 8 AM–4 PM (Timbers, West Wing, and Lower Indian Peaks Lodges only)
  • 1,000 vertical feet of intermediate terrain off Alpenglow, including Hornblower and International
  • A small Woodward Terrain Park in the base area
  • There will be no beginner terrain, Nordic skiing, snowshoeing, or uphill access at opening. More terrain will come online as snowmaking and natural snowfall allow.
  • Early-season conditions apply, so please respect all closures and signage and follow Your Responsibility Code. 

Check out our blog for all the details!

Check out the full AlpenGuy saga on our YouTube channel!

Been slacking on getting your pass? Summer pricing ENDS soon! Shop now at Eldora.com.

See you on the mountain on Tuesday!

report:
5:48 AM update – Good morning, skiers and riders! Welcome to the Eldora snow report for Closing Day, Sunday, April 5, 2026.

It's Closing Day—and also the second day of Retro Weekend, so break out your best retro gear and outfits and come hotdog with us today, the last day of the 25/26 season. It's shaping up to be a gorgeous day, with sunny skies, a high near 49, and calm breezes from the west.

You won't want to miss the party today! DJ Mista.Cal will be spinning 9-11 today in the BoomBox, and then The Scrubs kick off at 11:00 on Timbers Deck, followed by Cönnax from 1:00 to 4:00 PM.

Our GM & President, Andrew Gast, will be giving a toast at 3:00 PM today on Timbers Deck during a quick break in the Cönaxx set, and we'll also be giving away skis and a snowboard via a random drawing of everyone who entered our Spring Scan Challenge. If you're one of those people, don't forget to pick up your ticket at Timbers Tap House between 1:45 and 2:45, as instructed in the email we sent you yesterday.

Remember, lift tickets are only $49 today, so tell all of your friends without passes to come join you!

While we are sad to call it a season today, we are so happy to have seen your smiling faces so often this winter, and so grateful to our hardworking staff for providing us all with another great season at Eldora.

We'll see you soon!
